name: What is the cheapest way to convert a bathtub to a shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest way to convert a bathtub to a shower without creating future leak problems?
mainEntity.text: What is the cheapest way to convert a bathtub to a shower without creating future leak problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lowest-cost tub-to-shower conversion usually keeps the plumbing where it already is and uses a simple shower base or pan with prefabricated walls. That approach reduces demolition, framing, and tile labor. It can be a smart choice for rental properties, guest baths, or homeowners who want a clean update without a custom build. The danger is choosing the cheapest bid without checking what is included. Some low quotes leave out waterproofing details, upgraded valves, or proper surface preparation, which can cause failures later. Homeowners should focus on value, not just the sticker price. Ask whether the quote includes demolition, disposal, plumbing adjustments, waterproofing, wall finish, trim, and cleanup. If the bathroom has hidden damage, the true cheapest option may still require some repairs. Saving money is best done by simplifying the design, not by skipping the parts that keep the shower watertight.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cheapest option is usually a direct replacement that keeps the new shower in the same footprint, uses prefabricated wall panels, and avoids moving plumbing. Cutting corners on waterproofing is risky, because leaks behind the walls usually cost far more to fix later.
